This report separates the original selected-network-genome analysis from the
new analysis of complete genomes supplied by CheckV. The complete-genome
analysis preserves conservative and aggressive trimming results as separate
observations.

## Analysis setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
base_dir <- "~/Documents/ucla/research/project_coprolite_viromes/analysis/"
knitr::opts_chunk$set(root.dir = base_dir)

library(tidyverse)
source.files.from.dir <- function(directory) {
  full.path <- file.path(base_dir, directory)
  functions.list <- list.files(
    path = full.path,
    pattern = "*.R",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  sapply(functions.list, source)
  return(invisible(functions.list))
}
source.files.from.dir("stats")
source.files.from.dir("graphing")
source.files.from.dir("misc")

set.seed(seed = 123)
data_dir <-
  "~/Documents/ucla/research/project_coprolite_viromes_NOT_CODE/data/20260920"
figs_dir <-
  "~/Documents/ucla/research/project_coprolite_viromes_NOT_CODE/figures"
max_iter <- 1000
```

## Original CheckV analysis

The following selected-network-genome analysis was moved from the contig
report without changing its calculations.

### Selected-network-genome results

The selected network contigs define a focused genome subset. The analysis
counts all proteins on those contigs as denominators, applies the same
stringent VFDB-hit thresholds, keeps one dominant hit per ORF, and compares
qualifying-hit prevalence across sample groups.

```{r read in vfdb hits on network genomes}
# Parse every protein identifier to recover its sample, contig, and ORF.
all_contigs <- read.table(
  paste0(data_dir, "/proteins_all_ids.txt"),
  header = FALSE
  ) 
all_contigs <- all_contigs %>% 
  separate(V1, into = c("ori", "id", "contig"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>% 
  unite(sample, ori, id, sep = "_") %>%
  mutate(sample = str_replace(sample, "-", "."))
all_contigs <- all_contigs %>%
  separate(contig, into = c("contig_id", "orf_id"), sep = "_(?=[^_]+$)")

# Read the selected network contigs that define the focused subset.
best_contigs <- read.table(
  paste0(data_dir, "/proteins_best_ids.txt"),
  header = FALSE
  )
best_contigs <- best_contigs %>%
  separate(V1, into = c("ori", "id", "contig"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>%
  unite(sample, ori, id, sep = "_") %>%
  mutate(sample = str_replace(sample, "-", ".")) %>%
  rename(contig_id = contig)

# Count proteins on selected contigs to define each sample's denominator.
usable_proteins <- all_contigs %>%
  semi_join(best_contigs,
            by = c("sample" = "sample",
                   "contig_id" = "contig_id"))
all_contig_counts <- usable_proteins %>%
  count(sample, name = "total")

# Filter formatted HMMER hits, retain selected contigs, and keep the dominant
# qualifying hit per sample--contig--ORF combination.
hits <- read.csv(
  paste0(data_dir, "/proteins_all_hits_formatted.csv"),
  header = TRUE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    full_seq_evalue = as.numeric(full_seq_evalue),
    full_seq_score = as.numeric(full_seq_score),
    full_seq_bias = as.numeric(full_seq_bias)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    full_seq_evalue <= 1e-10,
    full_seq_score >= 25,
    full_seq_score >= 10 * full_seq_bias
  ) %>%
  semi_join(best_contigs,
            by = c("sample" = "sample",
                   "contig_id" = "contig_id")) %>%
  arrange(sample, contig_id, orf_id, full_seq_evalue, desc(full_seq_score)) %>%
  group_by(sample, contig_id, orf_id) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

hit_counts <- hits %>%
  count(query_name, sample) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  rename(VF_hit = query_name) %>%
  column_to_rownames("VF_hit")

# Convert selected-contig hit counts and protein totals to the shared summary
# matrix format.
hit_totals <- hit_counts %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "sample", values_to = "vfdb_count")
vf_hit_counts <- all_contig_counts %>%
  left_join(hit_totals, by = "sample") %>%
  mutate(proportion = vfdb_count / total)
vf_hit_counts[is.na(vf_hit_counts)] <- 0
vf_hit_counts <- vf_hit_counts %>%
  select(sample, vfdb_count, total, proportion) %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = value)
vf_hit_counts_t <- as.data.frame(t(vf_hit_counts))
vf_hit_counts_t$group <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(vf_hit_counts_t))
vf_hit_counts_t$country <- sub("^[^.]+\\.([A-Za-z]{3}).*$", "\\1", rownames(vf_hit_counts_t))
```

```{r analyze in vfdb hits on network genomes}
# Bootstrap medians of qualifying VFDB-hit ORFs per selected-contig protein.
vf_hit_boot_res <- get_row_median(
  data = vf_hit_counts,
  num_iter = max_iter, 
  row_num = 3,
  cats = c("ind", "pre", "pal")
  )
vf_hit_boot_res_by_country <- get_row_median(
  data = vf_hit_counts,
  num_iter = max_iter, 
  row_num = 3,
  cats = c("AUT", "AWC", "BMS", "ZAF", "ZAP",
           "CHN", "DNK", "ESP", "USA",
           "FJI", "MEX", "MDG", "TZA", "NPL", "PER")
  )
pal_size_vf_hit <- nrow(vf_hit_counts_t %>% filter(group == "pal"))
# Balance resampling to the number of paleofecal samples.
pal_size_vf_hit_boot_res_downsample <- get_row_median(
  data = vf_hit_counts,
  num_iter = max_iter, 
  row_num = 3,
  cats = c("ind", "pre", "pal"),
  max_resample = pal_size_vf_hit
  )

# Produce group, country, and balanced-group selected-contig violin plots.
vf_hit_voilin <- create_cat_voilins(
  data = vf_hit_boot_res, 
  ci_offset = c(0.15, 0.55, 0.55),
  file_name = "vf_perc_netGen",
  plot_dir = paste0(figs_dir, "/vf"),
  cats_order = c("pal", "pre", "ind"),
  plot.title = "Qualifying VFDB-hit ORFs per selected protein",
  x.title = "Sample group",
  y.title = "Qualifying VFDB-hit ORFs per selected protein"
  )
vf_hit_voilin[[1]]
vf_hit_voilin[[2]]
vf_hit_voilin_by_country <- create_cat_voilins(
  data = vf_hit_boot_res_by_country, 
  ci_offset = 0.3,
  file_name = "vf_perc_by_pop_netGen",
  plot_dir = paste0(figs_dir, "/vf"),
  cats_order = c("AUT", "AWC", "BMS", "ZAF", "ZAP",
                 "FJI", "MDG", "MEX", "NPL", "PER", "TZA",
                 "CHN", "DNK", "ESP", "USA"),
  plot.title = "Qualifying VFDB-hit ORFs per selected protein",
  x.title = "Sample origin",
  y.title = "Qualifying VFDB-hit ORFs per selected protein"
  )
vf_hit_voilin_by_country[[1]]
vf_hit_voilin_by_country[[2]]
vf_hit_voilin_downsampled <- create_cat_voilins(
  data = pal_size_vf_hit_boot_res_downsample, 
  ci_offset = c(0.15, 0.55, 0.55),
  file_name = "vf_perc_downsampled_netGen",
  plot_dir = paste0(figs_dir, "/vf"),
  cats_order = c("pal", "pre", "ind"),
  plot.title = "Qualifying VFDB-hit ORFs per selected protein",
  x.title = "Sample group",
  y.title = "Qualifying VFDB-hit ORFs per selected protein"
  )
vf_hit_voilin_downsampled[[1]]
vf_hit_voilin_downsampled[[2]]

# Test selected-contig prevalence differences among bootstrap distributions.
vf_hit <- melt(vf_hit_boot_res)
kruskal.test(vf_hit$value, vf_hit$Var2)
vf_hit_by_country <- melt(vf_hit_boot_res_by_country)
kruskal.test(vf_hit_by_country$value, vf_hit_by_country$Var2)
vf_hit_downsampled <- melt(pal_size_vf_hit_boot_res_downsample)
kruskal.test(vf_hit_downsampled$value, vf_hit_downsampled$Var2)
```

## Complete CheckV genome analysis

The complete-genome tables use checkv.filter plus genome.id as their key.
All summaries below therefore retain both trimming filters.

```{r read complete CheckV tables}
checkv.metadata <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "checkv_genome_metadata.csv"),
  check.names = TRUE
)
checkv.features <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "checkv_genome_features.csv"),
  check.names = TRUE
)
checkv.vf.hits <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "checkv_genome_vf_hits.csv"),
  check.names = TRUE
)
checkv.vf.stats <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "checkv_genome_vf_stats.csv"),
  check.names = TRUE
)
checkv.qc <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "checkv_genome_qc.csv"),
  check.names = TRUE
)

stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(
    checkv.metadata[c("checkv_filter", "genome_id")]
  ),
  !anyDuplicated(
    checkv.vf.stats[c("checkv_filter", "genome_id")]
  )
)

checkv.features <- checkv.features %>%
  rename(
    checkv.filter = checkv_filter,
    genome.id = genome_id,
    checkv.contig.id = checkv_contig_id,
    feature.id = feature_id,
    ec.number = ec_number,
    vf.id = vf_id,
    full.seq.evalue = full_seq_evalue,
    full.seq.score = full_seq_score,
    full.seq.bias = full_seq_bias,
    vf.description = vf_description
  )
```

### CheckV and PhaTYP lifestyle agreement

```{r CheckV PhaTYP lifestyle comparison}
checkv.metadata <- checkv.metadata %>%
  rename(
    checkv.filter = checkv_filter, 
    checkv.lifestyle = checkv_lifestyle, 
    phatyp.lifestyle = phatyp_lifestyle,
    phagcn.family = phagcn_family,
    genome.id = genome_id,
    checkv.contig.id = checkv_contig_id,
    genome.length = genome_length,
    checkv.source = checkv_source,
    checkv.warnings = checkv_warnings,
    phatyp.lifestyle.raw = phatyp_lifestyle_raw,
    phatyp.score = phatyp_score,
    phagcn.lineage = phagcn_lineage,
    phagcn.family.score = phagcn_family_score,
    phagcn.genus = phagcn_genus,
    phagcn.genus.cluster = phagcn_genus_cluster,
    checkv.raw.json = checkv_raw_json,
    phagcn.raw.json = phagcn_raw_json
    )
lifestyle.confusion <- checkv.metadata %>%
  count(
    checkv.filter,
    category,
    origin,
    checkv.lifestyle,
    phatyp.lifestyle,
    name = "genomes"
  )

lifestyle.agreement <- checkv.metadata %>%
  mutate(
    checkv.lifestyle.normalized = normalize.checkv.lifestyle(
      checkv.lifestyle
    ),
    phatyp.lifestyle.normalized = normalize.checkv.lifestyle(
      phatyp.lifestyle
    ),
    agrees = checkv.lifestyle.normalized == phatyp.lifestyle.normalized
  ) %>%
  count(checkv.filter, category, origin, agrees, name = "genomes")

lifestyle.confusion
lifestyle.agreement

lifestyle.agreement.plot <- lifestyle.agreement %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = checkv.filter,
      y = genomes,
      fill = agrees
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ origin, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    x = "CheckV trimming filter",
    y = "Fraction of complete genomes",
    fill = "Lifestyle agrees",
    title = "Agreement between CheckV-table and PhaTYP lifestyles"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
lifestyle.agreement.plot
```

### PhaGCN family summaries

```{r PhaGCN family summaries}
family.summary <- checkv.metadata %>%
  count(
    checkv.filter,
    category,
    origin,
    phatyp.lifestyle,
    phagcn.family,
    name = "genomes"
  ) %>%
  group_by(checkv.filter, category, origin, phatyp.lifestyle) %>%
  mutate(fraction = genomes / sum(genomes)) %>%
  ungroup()

family.summary

family.plot <- family.summary %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = phagcn.family,
      y = genomes,
      fill = phatyp.lifestyle
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black") +
  facet_grid(
    category + origin ~ checkv.filter,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "PhaGCN family",
    y = "Complete genomes",
    fill = "PhaTYP lifestyle",
    title = "PhaGCN family assignments"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
family.plot
```

### VFDB-hit prevalence by lifestyle

Prevalence is the number of qualifying VFDB-hit bacterial ORFs divided by the
number of eligible bacterial ORFs. Genomes without eligible bacterial ORFs
remain missing; genomes with eligible ORFs and no qualifying hit remain zero.

```{r VF prevalence by PhaTYP lifestyle}
checkv.vf.stats <- checkv.vf.stats %>%
  rename(
    checkv.filter = checkv_filter,
    genome.id = genome_id,
    checkv.contig.id = checkv_contig_id,
    eligible.bacterial.orfs = eligible_bacterial_orfs,
    qualifying.vf.orfs = qualifying_vf_orfs,
    vf.present = vf_present,
    vf.orf.prevalence = vf_orf_prevalence
  )
vf.plot.data <- checkv.vf.stats %>%
  left_join(
    checkv.metadata %>%
      select(
        checkv.filter,
        genome.id,
        phatyp.lifestyle,
        checkv.lifestyle
      ),
    by = c("checkv.filter", "genome.id")
  )

vf.by.phatyp.plot <- vf.plot.data %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = phatyp.lifestyle,
      y = vf.orf.prevalence,
      fill = phatyp.lifestyle
    )
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.45) +
  facet_grid(
    category + origin ~ checkv.filter,
    scales = "free_x"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "PhaTYP lifestyle",
    y = "Qualifying VFDB-hit bacterial ORFs / eligible bacterial ORFs",
    fill = "PhaTYP lifestyle",
    title = "Complete-genome VF prevalence by PhaTYP lifestyle"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
vf.by.phatyp.plot
```

```{r VF prevalence by CheckV lifestyle}
vf.by.checkv.plot <- vf.plot.data %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = checkv.lifestyle,
      y = vf.orf.prevalence,
      fill = checkv.lifestyle
    )
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.45) +
  facet_grid(
    category + origin ~ checkv.filter,
    scales = "free_x"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "CheckV-table lifestyle",
    y = "Qualifying VFDB-hit bacterial ORFs / eligible bacterial ORFs",
    fill = "CheckV lifestyle",
    title = "Complete-genome VF prevalence by supplied CheckV lifestyle"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
vf.by.checkv.plot
```

### Selected complete-genome feature map

The map displays one annotation class at a time. Positive-strand features are
above the genome backbone and negative-strand features are below it.

```{r selected complete genome feature map}
selected.genome.id <- "pre-TZA_ERS9106184_k141_65577"
selected.annotation <- "vf"

selected.features <- prepare.checkv.feature.map(
  features = checkv.features,
  selected.genome.id = selected.genome.id,
  selected.annotation = selected.annotation
)

if (nrow(selected.features) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No eligible ",
    selected.annotation,
    " features found for ",
    selected.genome.id
  )
}

selected.backbones <- checkv.metadata %>%
  filter(genome.id == selected.genome.id) %>%
  transmute(
    checkv.filter,
    backbone.start = 1,
    backbone.end = genome.length
  )
selected.features <- selected.features %>%
  inner_join(selected.backbones, by = "checkv.filter")

checkv.figs.dir <- file.path(figs_dir, "checkv")
dir.create(checkv.figs.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
selected.table.path <- file.path(
  checkv.figs.dir,
  paste0(
    str_replace_all(selected.genome.id, "[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_"),
    "_",
    selected.annotation,
    "_features.csv"
  )
)
write.csv(selected.features, selected.table.path, row.names = FALSE)
selected.features

annotation.colors <- c(
  viral = "#0072B2",
  bacterial = "#D55E00",
  vf = "#009E73"
)
selected.map <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(
    data = selected.backbones,
    aes(
      x = backbone.start,
      xend = backbone.end,
      y = 0,
      yend = 0
    ),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = selected.features,
    aes(
      x = start,
      xend = end,
      y = y,
      yend = y,
      color = annotation
    ),
    linewidth = 3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ checkv.filter, ncol = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = annotation.colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(-1, 0, 1),
    labels = c("Negative", "Genome", "Positive"),
    limits = c(-1.4, 1.4)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Genome coordinate",
    y = "Feature strand",
    color = "Annotation",
    title = paste(selected.annotation, "features on", selected.genome.id)
  ) +
  theme_bw()
selected.map

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    checkv.figs.dir,
    paste0(
      str_replace_all(selected.genome.id, "[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_"),
      "_",
      selected.annotation,
      "_map.svg"
    )
  ),
  plot = selected.map,
  width = 10,
  height = 5
)
```
